suffix: Answer from the code in this repository. Be specific: give repository-relative file paths, and line numbers where useful. Do not modify any files. In your final answer, report the findings only; do not describe which tools or steps you used.

tasks.prompt: Where does this app handle in-app purchases and subscriptions: loading products, buying, restoring purchases, and deciding whether the user has premium access? List the key files and the main types and functions involved.

Which functions call `TripPlanningService.importTrip`? List each caller with its file and line.
Where is the `SettingsManager` class (cinder/App/SettingsManager.swift) used across the codebase, including the watch app? List every file that uses it.
Give an architecture overview of this repository: the app and extension targets, the local Swift packages, the main layers or feature folders, and how they depend on each other.
Which files depend on cinder/Services/WorkoutPlanScheduler.swift (use the types or functions it declares)? List each file and what it uses.
